% 2-D lattice with a long ("bad") basis and a reduced ("good") basis; the
% fundamental parallelepiped of the good basis is tinted.  Toy lattice
% generated by b1 = (2,1), b2 = (1,3) -- volume 5.
\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{crypto-tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.42]
  \clip (-6.3,-5.3) rectangle (8.8,7.3);
  % fundamental domain of the reduced basis
  \fill[crtint] (0,0) -- (2,1) -- (3,4) -- (1,3) -- cycle;
  % lattice points a*(2,1) + b*(1,3)
  \foreach \a in {-8,...,8}
    \foreach \b in {-5,...,5}
      \node[lpt] at ({2*\a+\b},{\a+3*\b}) {};
  % bad basis: c1 = 3 b1 + b2 = (7,6), c2 = 2 b1 + b2 = (5,5)
  \draw[->, crmuted, line width=0.7pt] (0,0) -- (7,6) node[above right, text=crink2] {$\mathbf{c}_1$};
  \draw[->, crmuted, line width=0.7pt] (0,0) -- (5,5) node[above left, text=crink2] {$\mathbf{c}_2$};
  % good basis
  \draw[->, cr1, line width=1pt] (0,0) -- (2,1) node[below right, text=crink] {$\mathbf{b}_1$};
  \draw[->, cr1, line width=1pt] (0,0) -- (1,3) node[left, text=crink] {$\mathbf{b}_2$};
  \node[circle, fill=crink, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3pt, label={[font=\footnotesize]below left:$\mathbf{0}$}] at (0,0) {};
  \node[op, anchor=west, align=left, fill=white, inner sep=2pt] at (-6,-4.4) {grey: long basis $\mathbf{c}_1,\mathbf{c}_2$\\blue: reduced basis};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
